model.demand_paths: all 2^4 paths enumerated and paired exactly under each process; no Monte Carlo sampling
model.development: MIS-v2 learning-by-doing from productive effort; no separate development action or monetary cost
model.future_information: all policies use the declared exogenous demand law; only FIXED-OPT optimizes its fixed map and HLS uses continuation values
model.objective: sum over periods of equal-weight mean capped requirement fulfilment; success separately reported
model.observation: all policies observe current task and true current competence; no future realized task is exposed
model.resource_accounting: production effort is both constrained resource and MIS-v2 exposure; never subtracted a second time

title: Anticipatory Capability Development in Dynamic Technical Operations
